Scene Director 3.9.0-beta.1 — a Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized test app for **Apple Silicon (M1 or newer), macOS 13+**.

Download **Scene_Director_3.9.0-beta.1_macOS_arm64.zip**, extract it, then move **Scene Director.app** to Applications. Python is bundled. LM Studio or another compatible local language-model server is still required; image input and dataset captioning require a vision-capable model.

This version includes the full 3.9 Prompt Studio and LoRA Dataset update from PR #1:
- Separate creative/precise generation profiles, prompt actions, favorites, History, saved briefs, rotating choices and ComfyUI queuing.
- Crop ratios, buckets, size constraints, zoom/pan, folder imports, auto crop, caption scripts, parallel captions, review tools, folder/ZIP exports and training metadata.
- Review fixes: multiline prompts remain intact in History and hand edits; New version retains each slot's choices after deletion/reopening; Stop interrupts connected vision requests and rejects late results.

The app and nested native code are signed with Developer ID and hardened runtime. The Apple notarization ticket is stapled. Signatures, Gatekeeper acceptance, portable HTTPS roots, bundled-service checks and an isolated native-window launch were verified on the build and again after extracting the final archive. The attached **.signing.json** report records those checks, the exact source revision and the archive SHA-256; the **.sha256** file verifies the ZIP download.

Source: the `scene-director-3.9` branch and [PR #1](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/Scene-Director/pull/1). This is a private prerelease; previous downloads are unchanged. Settings, saved API keys and dataset sessions live outside the app bundle. Source validation includes 102 Python and 30 Node checks. The local service starts without DNS lookups. Source and model-flow checks use mock services; live-model output quality, real ComfyUI workflows and older supported macOS versions have not been evaluated for this test.
